opportunities.title: Funding for universities and research institutions

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £250,000 - £1 million; minimum grant amount £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-intensive universities and research institutions undertaking internationally competitive research; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and major equipment to enable high-quality research, and sometimes to improve access to research libraries or public engagement with science. Two-stage application process.

opportunities.title: Funding for special schools and colleges

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 - £75,000; minimum grant amount £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing special educational needs support at secondary/post-16 level; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment supporting pupils at secondary level to develop employment or independent living skills.

opportunities.title: Funding for libraries & archives

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £15,000 - £100,000; minimum grant amount £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating an accredited library or archive holding a nationally significant collection; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for collection storage facilities and research, education or interpretation spaces to improve access to nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for museums & galleries

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 - £500,000; minimum grant amount £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority operating an accredited museum or gallery holding a nationally significant collection; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces to improve display and interpretation of nationally significant collections.

opportunities.title: Funding for performing arts organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 - £150,000; minimum grant amount £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority focused on professional performance, with significant education work; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for building or refurbishing training and education facilities, and occasionally specialist equipment, for performing arts organisations.

opportunities.title: Funding for historic buildings & landscapes

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £15,000 - £100,000; minimum grant amount £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority managing sites of outstanding historic, architectural and cultural significance, open to the public; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for conservation and restoration work, interpretation, and education spaces at historic buildings, landscapes, parks and gardens.

opportunities.title: Funding for public engagement with science organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £250,000 - £750,000; minimum grant amount £100,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent), local authority or university with significant scientific or natural history collections of national significance; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for refurbishing or creating new galleries and education/learning spaces to improve public engagement with science through the history of science.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with disability

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 - £75,000; minimum grant amount £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working with disability, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment helping people with disabilities to live more independently, focusing on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working in mental health

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 - £75,000; minimum grant amount £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority working in mental health, with at least a 'Good' regulator rating where applicable; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for charities working in mental health, with emphasis on training, employment and supported housing.

opportunities.title: Funding for charities working with older people

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £40,000 - £75,000; minimum grant amount £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered or exempt charity (or equivalent) or local authority providing care and services for older people, particularly those with neurodegenerative conditions or who are isolated; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment and equipment for organisations providing care and services for older people.

opportunities.title: Funding for hospices and palliative care organisations

amount.raw: Usual grant range: £50,000 - £150,000; minimum grant amount £25,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered charities or hospices operating within the NHS, providing excellent care to patients and their families; UK only.
opportunities.summary: Capital grants for new buildings, refurbishment work and equipment for hospices and palliative care organisations.
